title: 02. Ingestion & Chunking: Chunk Size Selection — Tradeoffs
summary: Chunk size is the single most impactful hyperparameter in RAG systems — more impactful than the choice of vector database or even the embedding model.
objectives: ② Key Code: Empirical Chunk Size Selection

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Chunk size is the single most impactful hyperparameter in RAG systems — more impactful than the choice of vector database or even the embedding model. Too small: chunks lack enough context for the LLM to generate a complete answer, and similar-sounding but distinct passages create retrieval noise. Too large: semantic specificity is lost (the embedding of a 2000-token chunk is an average of many topics), retrieval precision drops, and context windows overflow. The optimal chunk size depends on: document type (narrative text vs tables vs code), query type (specific vs exploratory), LLM context window size, and embedding model token limit.

sections.title: ② Key Code: Empirical Chunk Size Selection
sections.body:
```python
import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Dict
from ragas import evaluate
from ragas.metrics import context_recall, context_precision, faithfulness
from datasets import Dataset
from langchain_text_splitters import RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_community.vectorstores import Chroma

@dataclass
class ChunkSizeResult:
    chunk_size: int
    overlap: int
    context_recall: float
    context_precision: float
    faithfulness: float
    avg_chunk_tokens: float
    num_chunks: int

async def find_optimal_chunk_size(
    documents: List,
    test_cases: List[Dict],
    llm,
    chunk_sizes: List[int] = [128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048],
    overlaps: List[int] = [0, 32, 64, 128]
) -> List[ChunkSizeResult]:
    """
    Empirically evaluate different chunk sizes on your corpus.
    Returns ranked results to guide chunk size selection.
    """
    import tiktoken
    enc = tiktoken.encoding_for_model("text-embedding-3-large")
    results = []
    
    for chunk_size in chunk_sizes:
        for overlap in overlaps:
            if overlap >= chunk_size:
                continue
            
            # Build vector store with this config
            splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(
                chunk_size=chunk_size,
                chunk_overlap=overlap,
                length_function=lambda t: len(enc.encode(t))
            )
            chunks = splitter.split_documents(documents)
            
            avg_tokens = sum(len(enc.encode(c.page_content)) for c in chunks) / len(chunks)
            
            embeddings = OpenAIEmbeddings(model="text-embedding-3-small")
            vs = Chroma.from_documents(chunks, embeddings, collection_name=f"test_{chunk_size}_{overlap}")
            retriever = vs.as_retriever(search_kwargs={"k": 5})
            
            # Run evaluation
            eval_data = []
            for case in test_cases:
                docs = await retriever.ainvoke(case["question"])
                answer = await llm.ainvoke(
                    f"Context: {' '.join(d.page_content for d in docs)}\nQ: {case['question']}"
                )
                eval_data.append({
                    "question": case["question"],
                    "answer": answer.content,
                    "contexts": [d.page_content for d in docs],
                    "ground_truth": case["ground_truth"]
                })
            
            scores = evaluate(
                Dataset.from_list(eval_data),
                metrics=[context_recall, context_precision, faithfulness]
            )
            
            results.append(ChunkSizeResult(
                chunk_size=chunk_size,
                overlap=overlap,
                context_recall=float(scores["context_recall"]),
                context_precision=float(scores["context_precision"]),
                faithfulness=float(scores["faithfulness"]),
                avg_chunk_tokens=avg_tokens,
                num_chunks=len(chunks)
            ))
            
            # Clean up
            vs.delete_collection()
    
    # Rank by composite score (weighted)
    results.sort(
        key=lambda r: r.context_recall * 0.4 + r.context_precision * 0.3 + r.faithfulness * 0.3,
        reverse=True
    )
    
    print(f"\n{'Size':>6} {'Overlap':>7} {'Recall':>8} {'Precision':>10} {'Faith':>7} {'Chunks':>7}")
    print("-" * 55)
    for r in results[:10]:
        print(f"{r.chunk_size:>6} {r.overlap:>7} {r.context_recall:>8.3f} "
              f"{r.context_precision:>10.3f} {r.faithfulness:>7.3f} {r.num_chunks:>7}")
    
    return results
```

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
CHUNK SIZE TRADEOFFS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

TOO SMALL (< 128 tokens):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Document: "Refunds within 30 days. Items must be unopened."

Chunk: "Refunds within 30 days."    ← Only half the context!
                                       LLM doesn't know about "unopened"

Problems:
  ✗ Multiple chunks needed for one answer
  ✗ Embedding captures only narrow meaning
  ✗ Similar sentences from different sections retrieved together

TOO LARGE (> 2048 tokens):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Chunk: "Chapter 3: Customer Policies [2000 tokens]"
  Contains: refund policy, warranty, shipping, returns, exchanges...
  
  Embedding = average of ALL these topics = generic vector
  
Problems:
  ✗ Query "refund policy" matches any document with the word "policy"
  ✗ Retrieved chunk is too long, may overflow context window
  ✗ LLM has to read lots of irrelevant content

GOLDILOCKS ZONE (256-1024 tokens):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Chunk: "Refund Policy: Items may be returned within 30 days of 
        purchase. Items must be unopened and in original packaging.
        A receipt is required. Processing takes 5-7 business days."

  Embedding captures SPECIFIC "refund policy" semantics ✓
  Chunk contains COMPLETE context for this topic ✓
  Fits in context window without overflow ✓

DECISION GUIDE:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Query type              Optimal chunk size
─────────────────────────────────────────────
Single fact retrieval   128-256 tokens
Topic question          256-512 tokens (DEFAULT)
Procedural steps        512-1024 tokens
Legal/policy clauses    1024-2048 tokens
Code functions          Variable (function-complete)

Embedding model limit (HARD CEILING):
  text-embedding-3-large:  8,191 tokens
  BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5:  512 tokens (soft limit, performance degrades above 512)
  Cohere embed-v4:         512 tokens optimal

Context window budget:
  If LLM context = 128k tokens and top_k = 5:
  Max chunk size = 128,000 / 5 = 25,600 tokens (absurd)
  But LLM performance degrades with long contexts → keep chunks small
```
